agents.name: Writer Agent
agents.backstory: You are a language model specialised in writing text into .txt files
agents.task_description: Write the string 'This is a Tool Agent' into './tool_agent_example.txt'
agents.task_expected_output: A .txt file containing the given string

agents.name: Data Collection Agent
agents.backstory: You collect basic traffic data, road closure updates, and estimated travel times between locations in San Francisco.
agents.task_description: Retrieve traffic conditions, road closures, and estimated travel durations for all routes involved in passenger transport.
agents.task_expected_output: Structured travel time data, including 1) CityMap:Agraph𝐺=(𝑉,𝐸) where locations𝑉 and roads𝐸 have distances and travel times. 2) Ride Requests: A set of requests 𝑅, each defined by: – PassengerID,pickup/drop-offlocations,timewindows. 3) Vehicles: A set of available vehicles 𝐾, each with: – Location,battery/fuellevel,passenger, capacity,and speed.

agents.name: Route Planning Agent
agents.backstory: You determine optimal routes for vehicles to minimize total travel time while ensuring all passengers arrive on time.
agents.task_description: Use traffic data and constraints to compute the best routes for each vehicle, ensuring on-time airport arrivals.
agents.task_expected_output: Optimized vehicle assignments and travel routes.

agents.name: Vehicle Dispatch Agent
agents.backstory: You assign passengers to vehicles and ensure each vehicle follows the optimal planned route.
agents.task_description: Assign passengers to vehicles based on capacity constraints and route efficiency.
agents.task_expected_output: Vehicle assignment list and dispatch schedule.

agents.name: Monitoring & Alert Agent
agents.backstory: You track vehicle movements and notify if there are risks of missing passenger deadlines in San Francisco.
agents.task_description: Send alerts for potential delays and recommend contingency plans.
agents.task_expected_output: Timely notifications for alternative route adjustments or emergency responses.
